title: Integral reconstruction comparison data
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum, coefficient prime $\ell$ distinct from its characteristic, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$, separated finite-type schemes $X,Y$ over the algebraic closure, and a compactification $f=pj$ with $j:X\hookrightarrow Z$ open and $p:Z\to Y$ proper. Use these notions from [def-weil-finite-field-fiber], [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension], [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties], [def-sbc-smooth-morphisms]. Use the actual completed integral sheaves, full derived-complete constructible categories, strict coefficient towers and normalized constructible towers of [def-weil-completed-integral-coefficients], [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed], [sk-def-sp-coefficient-towers], [sk-def-sp-normalized-towers]. Use the recorded reduction/limit adjunction presentations [det-sp-normalized-equivalence], separately derived compactification support [det-sp-integral-direct-image-tower], tower support/right adjunction [det-sp-tower-gluing] and its section-preserving coordinates [det-sp-tower-gamma]. Define $L_T$ as the actual total derived inverse limit after scalar restriction, $r_T$ as derived reduction on the full integral category, $F=Rp_*j_!$, and $H=L_XG_\bullet r_Y$, restricting their targets to the full constructible categories when membership proofs are given. Ordinary conjugation is the equivalence counit comparison, and the compactification tower-word comparison is its separately derived open/pushforward composition.

Define Reconstruction to be the type of data consisting of: Noetherianity of X and Y; constructible reduction of every integral object; normalization and integral constructibility of $G_\bullet r_YK$ and its total limit; constructibility of F; full faithfulness of both reductions; a reduction presentation on Z; normalized limit and evaluation presentations on X,Z,Y; scalar squares and the normalized scalar comparison of [def-sp-complete-compactification-scalar-comparison-data]; natural isomorphisms $b:r_YF\simeq F_\bullet r_X$ and $c:r_XH\simeq G_\bullet r_Y$; object isomorphisms $\alpha_M:FM\simeq L_YF_\bullet r_XM$ whose forward arrows are exactly the canonical word of [def-sp-complete-compactification-limit-comparison] followed by total limit of the tower-word comparison; the equation $b_M=r_Y(\alpha_M)$ followed by the actual reduction/limit counit; and the equation identifying $c_K$ with that actual counit. Include equivalences between the full integral and normalized constructible categories whose forward functors are exactly reduction and whose inverse functors are exactly total limit, and preservation of normalized towers by both given tower functors (so their specified ambient adjunction restricts without changing its maps). Finally include reconstruction isomorphisms $u_A:A\simeq L_Tr_TA$ whose forward arrows are the actual reconstruction units, and $a=u_A L_T(r_Ta)u_B^{-1}$ in diagrammatic composition order for every actual morphism $a:A\to B$. Define reconstructionResult by deriving quasi-compactness of f from finite-type X and separated Y, and compactifiability from the given j,p, and using the same Reconstruction type. This defines the data type only; no inhabitance is asserted.
